study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Bank identity is not pair-level overlap. Different digests can contain identical pairs. No URL was fetched; no independence or settlement claim is derived.

pin.estimand: Fresh-input token_delta replication of 4fb8505bf179ee718bd7fa3ae978ef1e849f93f6684dca852b9fa6492fdfc0c2: complete Ainglish truth marker reply minus the complete careful-English truth-conditional mapping over 32 exchanges, balanced sixteen per marker; equal marker mean per cl100k/o200k/p50k tokenizer, maximum tokenizer mean with member-span interval, aggregate only.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 32 fresh complete question-and-reply exchanges, balanced sixteen per truth marker across written negation, lexical negatives, quantifiers, and positive questions
manifest.selection: Sixteen wholly fresh polar questions were frozen before tokenizer import and crossed with both markers. The question mix covers contracted and written negation, lexical negatives, quantifiers, double negation, and positive questions. English arms use the proposal's complete truth-conditional mapping and retain every written negation; Ainglish arms differ only in the registered complete reply marker.
manifest.method: Compute Ainglish minus English tokens per pair for each pinned tokenizer; average within each marker, average the two marker means equally, and report the maximum tokenizer mean as least-favourable token_delta. Retain every finite outcome.

estimand.population: the 32 complete fresh question-and-reply pairs frozen in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: equal marker mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.interpretation: token cost of a truth-value reply whose written negations retain scope, not a comparison with ambiguous yes/no

manifest.freeze: The API retained the canonical manifest before this process imported tiktoken or observed token counts.
